name: perl-git-bz
description: git-bz: a tool for integrating git with Bugzilla

scripts.preversion: sed -i -e "s/^our \$VERSION = .*/our \$VERSION = 'v$npm_new_version';/" lib/GitBz/Version.pm; perl scripts/stamp-changelog.pl v$npm_new_version; git add -u; rm -f lib/GitBz/Version.pm-e
scripts.postversion: perl scripts/open-next-changelog.pl v$npm_package_version; git add CHANGELOG.md; git commit -m 'Open next development cycle'

author: Koha Community
